summary: Asked who made the campaign possible, an organizer identifies the neighbors who started showing up first.
realLife: Peters credited local Catholic volunteers with much of the county campaign’s early work.
gates: The organizer witnessed the campaign’s beginnings.
inGame: needs: a volunteer's first shift and a later account naming the early crew.

turns.what: The organizer remembers the kitchen where they met and asks a neighbor for the names.
turns.pulledBy: The organizer joined after the first meeting.
turns.writesBack: The account records the place and leaves the first names open for confirmation.

turns.what: A volunteer brings an old sign-in sheet after the account appears.
turns.pulledBy: The first account omitted someone who worked the opening shift.
turns.writesBack: The corrected account credits the missing volunteer.
